author: ShadowStrike999
body:
Hello this is my ban appeal:

  • My username is ShadowStrike999
  • I was Perm-Banned for fly hacking
  • I would like to be unbanned as I feel like I have grown more mature and not to make silly mistakes like this one again and I'd like to play your server w/ my friends.
  • I did fly hack. Thought it was by accident it did happen and I know I need to face punishment but its been 10 months since the ban and I'm hoping that you guys (Staff) will having a forgiving heart.
  • I've waited 10 months to be unbanned from your network.
  • I have not ban evaded before on any server.
  • I have appealed previously about 3 or 4 months ago and I'm back to appeal again.
Thank you and have a great day,
Shadow

title: Second Ban Appeal

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Greetings, ShadowStrike999.

Seeing as you've spent a sufficient amount of time banned, and you have not attempted to ban evade your punishment, I will be appealing your infraction.

It is apparent that you have learned from your mistakes and corrected them, so I'll just toss a friendly reminder to abide by the rules this time. That being said, your ban should be lifted soon enough and you will be able to join back the server.

Have fun in-game. Sincerely,
- timaeusTestified | Senior Moderator
